text: {"lessons":["My account rose for two periods and then fell for two; with prices moving randomly, that short history is not a reliable signal about what comes next.","The recent losses bother me more than the earlier gains pleased me, so I should avoid making fear-driven trades and base decisions on a deliberate plan.","I made no trades, and that was a valid choice; since I check in only a few times a year, I should review periodically and trade only when there is a clear reason."]}
